name: Pulse Forge
tagline: Design a Doom-style monster or gun, get an exact art order, cut the painting into game-ready sprites.
overview: Pulse Forge is a free web app (phone, PC, any browser, no account) that builds Doom-style monsters and weapons for EOD. You design the creature or gun with a DNA builder, copy an exact art order for a painter, then drop the finished picture back in: the cutter removes the background, finds every frame, labels it, sizes it for Doom and crushes it into the Doom palette. One tap sends it to EOD's painted-art library on the same device.

capabilities.title: Monster DNA builder
capabilities.text: 26 monster types, size, colors, art style, behavior and 20 parts, each Yes, No or 🎲 (maybe).

proofs.caption: Spiked demon dog, Large, Hellfire orange: Claws and Fangs Yes, Glowing eyes 🎲

capabilities.title: Weapon DNA builder
capabilities.text: 21 weapon types and 20 gun parts, plus how many firing frames, floor pickup and projectile frames to draw.

proofs.caption: Weapons tab: Electric minigun with rotating barrels, drum magazine, glowing vents and 6 firing frames

capabilities.title: Art order for the painter
capabilities.text: Plain text the painter follows: style, parts in and out, colors and a fixed sheet layout on solid magenta so a program can cut it. Copy art order puts it on the clipboard, or selects it when the browser blocks copying.

proofs.caption: Turn Horns and Spikes to Yes: the order's PARTS line updates at once
Copy art order: this browser blocked the clipboard, so Forge selected the text instead (the fallback added in 0.1.1)

capabilities.title: 🔒 Locks and 🎲 Randomize
capabilities.text: Lock any part and Randomize rolls a new seed, type, size, colors and parts but keeps what you locked.

proofs.caption: Before: Horns and Claws locked (gold padlocks)
After 🎲 Randomize: new seed and type, Horns and Claws still Yes

capabilities.title: Families (variants)
capabilities.text: Standard, Armored, Elite, Elemental or Boss with the same DNA makes a family of one creature.

proofs.caption: Standard variant
Boss variant, same DNA: Armor and Pauldrons join the parts list

capabilities.title: Save and load DNA
capabilities.text: Save DNA downloads the design as a small file; Load DNA brings it back exactly.

proofs.caption: A sample DNA file loaded: Floating skull, Ice blue, Elemental, DNA 777

capabilities.title: Cutter: background out, frames found
capabilities.text: Drop or paste the painting. Forge finds the background color from the edges and floods it away, ignores thin lines and specks, joins nearby pieces and puts the drawings in reading order.

proofs.caption: A demo sheet (5 angles + 5 death frames on magenta) dropped in, original shown above the cut frames
10 frames found and labeled from the order's layout: Front, Angle 2–5, Death 1–4, Corpse

capabilities.title: Change any label
capabilities.text: Every frame has a label picker (Front, Walk 1, Death 1, Firing 1, Pickup, Ignore…) you can change.

proofs.caption: Second frame relabeled to Ignore by hand

capabilities.title: Doom size and Doom colors
capabilities.text: Frames are scaled to game height (a Doom imp is 56) and crushed into the Doom palette; both can be changed.

proofs.caption: Game height 100 with Doom colors off: frames grow to about 100 tall
Back to 56 with Doom colors on: 52×56 front frame

capabilities.title: Grid mode
capabilities.text: For busy backgrounds, cut by a grid of columns × rows instead.

proofs.caption: By grid, 5 columns × 2 rows: ten cells cut and labeled

capabilities.title: Send to EOD
capabilities.text: One tap saves the creature in the Forge library on this device; EOD's generator lists it under Painted art, marked ⚒.

proofs.caption: Send to EOD library: "Demo Baron is in your Forge library"
Same browser, EOD's monster generator: Painted art shows ⚒ Demo Baron

capabilities.title: My Forge art library
capabilities.text: Cards for everything you made, with Export, Load DNA and Delete (Delete asks first; maps that use it keep their copy).

proofs.caption: Delete asks with ✔ / ↶ (cancelled here)
Load DNA from the card puts the creature's design back in the builder

capabilities.title: Export a creature
capabilities.text: Export on a card (or Export every creature) makes one zip per creature: named PNG frames, DNA.json and the art order.

proofs.caption: Export: Demo_Baron zip made (on the bench it held angle-1…5, death-1…5, DNA.json, art-order.txt, README.txt)

capabilities.title: Ghost manual
capabilities.text: 👻 opens a plain-words guide to the four steps.

proofs.caption: The 👻 manual
